access_logs_deny_reason_ck.name: access_logs_deny_reason_ck
access_logs_deny_reason_ck.value: deny_reason IS NULL OR deny_reason IN ('NOT_FOUND', 'LINK_REVOKED', 'NOT_MEMBER', 'USER_DISABLED', 'SUSPENDED', 'FILE_EXPIRED', 'NOT_STARTED', 'ENDED', 'LINK_EXPIRED', 'DOWNLOAD_NOT_ALLOWED', 'PASSWORD_REQUIRED', 'PASSWORD_INVALID', 'VIEW_LIMIT_REACHED')

access_logs_ticket_ck.name: access_logs_ticket_ck
access_logs_ticket_ck.value: result = 'granted' OR (ticket_hash IS NULL AND ticket_expires_at IS NULL AND delivered_at IS NULL)

access_logs_granted_ck.name: access_logs_granted_ck
access_logs_granted_ck.value: result <> 'granted' OR ticket_expires_at IS NOT NULL

audit_logs_target_type_ck.name: audit_logs_target_type_ck
audit_logs_target_type_ck.value: target_type IS NULL OR target_type IN ('user', 'invite', 'folder', 'member', 'file', 'share_link', 'system')

audit_logs_target_ck.name: audit_logs_target_ck
audit_logs_target_ck.value: target_id IS NULL OR target_type IS NOT NULL

files_expires_at_idx.name: files_expires_at_idx
files_expires_at_idx.where: status = 'active' AND expires_at IS NOT NULL

files_display_name_ck.name: files_display_name_ck
files_display_name_ck.value: char_length(display_name) BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND display_name = btrim(display_name)

files_original_filename_ck.name: files_original_filename_ck
files_original_filename_ck.value: char_length(original_filename) BETWEEN 1 AND 255 AND position('/' IN original_filename) = 0 AND position(E'\\' IN original_filename) = 0 AND original_filename !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'

files_view_range_ck.name: files_view_range_ck
files_view_range_ck.value: view_starts_at IS NULL OR view_ends_at IS NULL OR view_starts_at < view_ends_at

files_delete_reason_ck.name: files_delete_reason_ck
files_delete_reason_ck.value: delete_reason IS NULL OR delete_reason IN ('user', 'folder_deleted', 'expired', 'upload_abandoned', 'verification_failed')

files_deleted_ck.name: files_deleted_ck
files_deleted_ck.value: (status = 'deleted') = (deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND delete_reason IS NOT NULL)

files_pending_ck.name: files_pending_ck
files_pending_ck.value: status <> 'pending' OR upload_expires_at IS NOT NULL

files_active_ck.name: files_active_ck
files_active_ck.value: status <> 'active' OR (activated_at IS NOT NULL AND upload_expires_at IS NULL)

folders_name_ck.name: folders_name_ck
folders_name_ck.value: char_length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND name = btrim(name)

invites_signup_open_email_uq.name: invites_signup_open_email_uq
invites_signup_open_email_uq.where: purpose = 'signup' AND used_at IS NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL

invites_reset_open_user_uq.name: invites_reset_open_user_uq
invites_reset_open_user_uq.where: purpose = 'password_reset' AND used_at IS NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL

invites_role_ck.name: invites_role_ck
invites_role_ck.value: role IS NULL OR role IN ('admin', 'user')

invites_purpose_fields_ck.name: invites_purpose_fields_ck
invites_purpose_fields_ck.value: (purpose = 'signup' AND role IS NOT NULL AND user_id IS NULL) OR (purpose = 'password_reset' AND role IS NULL AND user_id IS NOT NULL)

invites_used_revoked_ck.name: invites_used_revoked_ck
invites_used_revoked_ck.value: used_at IS NULL OR revoked_at IS NULL

profiles_display_name_ck.name: profiles_display_name_ck
profiles_display_name_ck.value: char_length(display_name) BETWEEN 1 AND 50 AND display_name = btrim(display_name)

share_links_max_views_ck.name: share_links_max_views_ck
share_links_max_views_ck.value: max_views IS NULL OR max_views BETWEEN 1 AND 10000

share_links_view_count_ck.name: share_links_view_count_ck
share_links_view_count_ck.value: view_count >= 0 AND (max_views IS NULL OR view_count <= max_views)

share_links_password_hash_ck.name: share_links_password_hash_ck
share_links_password_hash_ck.value: password_hash IS NULL OR password_hash LIKE 'scrypt$%'

share_links_revoke_reason_ck.name: share_links_revoke_reason_ck
share_links_revoke_reason_ck.value: revoke_reason IS NULL OR revoke_reason IN ('user', 'reissued', 'file_deleted', 'folder_deleted')

share_links_revoked_by_ck.name: share_links_revoked_by_ck
share_links_revoked_by_ck.value: revoked_by IS NULL OR revoked_at IS NOT NULL
